caption: The drawing depicts a single upholstered armchair positioned centrally within a rectangular frame. The chair features a rounded back and a wide, cushioned seat. Both the backrest and seat are covered in a light beige or tan fabric decorated with a floral pattern consisting of blue, red, pink, and green flowers and vines. The chair has wooden armrests and legs; the armrests are brown and elegantly curved with scrolled ends, while the legs are cabriole style with gentle curves and feet that flare outward. The upholstery is fastened along the seat border with a row of brass-colored tacks or studs. The background of the drawing is plain and off-white, with the chair shown in full view and no other objects or elements present.
title: Armchair
